evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Jules: 'Hi, this is Jules from Einstein Moving Company.' Later: 'Bye, John.' Name collected at top, used at close.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No recognizable framing present. Rep launches into details collection without time-boxed expectation-setting or promise of a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly to logistics without surfacing customer's top concerns about the move.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were raised by the customer during step 2, so this is not applicable.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection offered. No summary of customer's priorities or concerns.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage mentioned at any point in the call.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent asked.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep asked about items in photos (refrigerator, washer/dryer, closet contents, beds), but no concern-led opening like 'What items in this move are you most concerned about?' Property type (townhome), stories (two), and moving destination (Lakeland) covered. Missing: walking distance at both ends, number of rooms beyond closets/bedrooms, additional spaces (garage, shed, study).
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Packing asked: 'Do you need help packing like boxing things?' Box count asked: 'I just gonna review this... the boxes we would need would be anywhere from like fifty to seventy boxes.'
evidence_quotes.value_days: Full value-days discussion present. Rep identified Saturday/Sunday as higher-cost days ($200/$92 per hour) and offered Monday–Thursday at $190/hour as a cheaper alternative: 'Friday has the same hour rate with Saturday. So Friday and Saturday are the most expensive days but if we're packing on a Monday or to Thursday the hourly rate is $190.' Savings framed as hourly rate difference, not total dollar amount, and flexibility not explicitly asked.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: No rate lock mentioned. No deposit policy stated. Move was booked without any explicit ask or rate commitment language.

top_strength: Jules successfully navigated the customer to a virtual walkthrough decision and routed the call cleanly without abandoning the pitch, qualifying the move as a walkthrough-scheduler case per the rubric.
coaching_note: Before routing to a walkthrough, Jules must ask the Two Concerns question (movers not showing up on time, damage to items) and deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) — these belong in step 3, before probing, even on walkthrough calls, per v4 sequencing.
